description: Permanently delete a project: its JSON, shortlist, versions, uploaded assets, and uploaded clips. Requires edit access — the owner, a workspace editor/admin/owner, or a direct-share editor; anyone else gets the opaque not-found. Deleting the last remaining project is allowed. The user's editor session won't auto-refresh — if they were viewing the deleted project they'll need to reload.
